==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity through sleep paralysis. I struggled to come up with a solution for where to hide the Death Staff. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Death Staff resembles a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy.) Every possibility I have thought of comes with a lot of potential risks. (I think the core issue is that I know so little about the Death Staff. Its powers are truly frightening, and I don't want to accidentally make things worse by improperly securing or destroying it.) In the end, I decided to use my geomancy to create a golem planet where the staff can be watched over. (This was my original plan, but I went over so many alternate scenarios before I decided that it was the best I could come up with.)
